items.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013
items.q: as best soloist the prize was I got a chance to play with Sarah Vaughan that night. She was on the bill, right? So I got a chance to sit in.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s how I felt about Cannonball. I got to play in front of him once. You just don’t ever forget those things.

You don’t forget that, man. And it’s like, you know, to me, I’ll never forget when I was 15, I was in high school, and I was in this jazz competition with my school band. And my band won, and I won best soloist. And so as best soloist the prize was I got a chance to play with Sarah Vaughan that night. She was on the bill, right? So I got a chance to sit in. So I came home and I told my brother, I said, “Man, I got Sarah Vaughan’s autograph.” He said, “Okay, did you get her telephone number?” And I went, “What?”…
By the way, you mentioned Louis Hayes.
